t: Button AL Structure — All Variants Optimized
d: Button is horizontal AL. Three sizing strategies depending on use case — never mix them in a single component; use variants. DEFAULT (hug width): horizontal AL, Hug width, Fixed height. Height by size: sm=32px, md=40px, lg=48px. Padding: sm=12px H / 0 V (height is fixed), md=20px H / 0 V, lg=24px H / 0 V. Gap: 8px. Children: optional leading-icon (Fixed 16px sm / 20px md / 20px lg), label text (Hug width — do NOT Fill here because the button Hugs around the text), optional trailing-icon (same as leading). FULL-WIDTH (fill container): horizontal AL, Fill width (or Fixed if known), Fixed height. Same padding. Label text: Hug width, aligned center via the 9-point grid (center-center alignment on the parent). Never use Fill on label in a centered button — that will push label to left edge. ICON-ONLY button: Fixed width × Fixed height (same as height per size). No padding needed — center alignment does the work. Single icon child: Fixed size. OPTIMIZATION: Set min-width on default buttons (e.g. 80px) so very short labels (like 'OK') don't produce undersized touch targets. RULE: Button height is always Fixed, never Hug — Hug height makes button height dependent on font metrics and breaks cross-platform consistency.

t: Input Field AL Structure — Input Frame Only
d: The input frame (the box itself, not the full field) is horizontal AL. Fill width, Fixed height (sm=32px, md=40px, lg=48px). Padding: 12px horizontal each side (independent padding: L=12, R=12). Gap: 8px. Alignment: center on cross-axis (children vertically centered). Children in order: (1) leading-icon (optional): Fixed 20×20, in-flow — not absolute. Keep in flow so padding adjusts naturally. (2) value/placeholder text: Fill width, Hug height. This is the most important sizing rule — text must Fill so it occupies all available horizontal space and does not push the trailing icon off-screen. (3) trailing-icon or clear-button (optional): Fixed 20×20, in-flow. BORDERS: applied as stroke on the input frame, not a separate layer. STATES: use variable modes or component properties to swap border colour (default → border-default, focus → action-primary, error → danger, disabled → border-subtle). OPTIMIZATION: Never use absolute position for leading/trailing icons in inputs — keeping them in-flow means padding automatically adjusts and the text fill works correctly. RULE: Input height is always Fixed. The text inside uses Hug height within a center-aligned parent.

t: Form Field Group — Label + Input + Helper Text
d: The full form field (label + input + helper) is vertical AL. Fill width, Hug height. Gap: 4px (tight — label-to-input and input-to-helper should feel visually connected). Children: (1) Label row: horizontal AL, Fill width, Hug height, gap 4px. Children: label text (Fill width, Hug height) + optional required-indicator asterisk (Fixed/Hug, align top). (2) Input frame (see al-050). (3) Helper/error row (optional, shown via boolean property): horizontal AL, Fill width, Hug height, gap 4px. Children: icon (Fixed 16×16) + helper text (Fill width, Hug height). SPACING BETWEEN FIELDS in a form: the form container is vertical AL with gap 16-24px between field group instances. Do not add margin to individual field components — control all spacing from the form container gap. ERROR STATE: swap helper text colour and input border colour via variable or component property. The helper row is always in-flow (not hidden via visibility) so the component height is stable — or use a boolean prop to show/hide it cleanly. OPTIMIZATION: Keep the label-to-input gap at 4px and the field-to-field gap at 16px+ so the label always reads as belonging to its input, not floating between two fields.

t: Checkbox and Radio Button AL Structure
d: Checkbox/Radio row: horizontal AL, Hug width and height (or Fill width if label wraps). Gap: 8px. Alignment: top (not center) — when label wraps to multiple lines, the control should align to the first line of text. Children: (1) Control frame: Fixed 20×20 (checkbox) or Fixed 20×20 (radio). This is the visual box/circle. Inside: vertical AL, center-center, contains the check icon or inner circle (Fixed 12×12), shown via boolean property. Never use absolute position inside the control — the icon is centered via AL alignment. (2) Label content: vertical AL, Hug or Fill, gap 2px. Children: primary label (Fill width if parent Fills, Hug if parent Hugs) + optional description (same). OPTIMIZATION: The control frame must be Fixed 20×20 regardless of what's inside. If the control were set to Hug, it would collapse when the inner icon is hidden. GROUP PATTERN: a list of checkboxes is vertical AL, Fill width, gap 12px. Each row is a checkbox instance. DISABLED STATE: use opacity variable or colour variable on text and control border — never rebuild the component.

t: Badge, Tag, and Chip AL Structure
d: All three are horizontal AL, Hug width, Fixed height. Alignment: center. BADGE (status indicator, number count): Fixed height 20px. Padding: 0px vertical (Fixed height handles it), 6px horizontal. Gap: 4px. Children: optional icon (Fixed 12×12) + label (Hug). Border-radius: radius/full (9999px) for pill shape. Min-width: 20px so single-digit numbers are circular, not oval. TAG (label, filter, removable): Fixed height 24-28px. Padding: 0 vertical, 8px horizontal. Gap: 4px. Children: optional leading-icon (Fixed 14×14) + label (Hug) + optional remove-icon (Fixed 14×14). Border-radius: radius/sm (4px) or radius/full depending on style. CHIP (interactive, selectable): Fixed height 32px. Padding: 0 vertical, 12px horizontal. Gap: 6px. Children: optional icon (Fixed 16×16) + label (Hug) + optional trailing (checkmark or close). Border-radius: radius/full or radius/md. OPTIMIZATION: Min-width on badges prevents single-character badges from collapsing. All three use Hug width — do NOT use Fill unless the design calls for equal-width chips in a grid. The Fixed height eliminates vertical padding math — just center the content.

t: List Item AL Structure — Icon + Content + Action
d: List item: horizontal AL, Fill width, Hug height (min-height 48px for touch compliance). Padding: 16px horizontal, 12px vertical. Gap: 12px between the three sections. Alignment: center on cross-axis (children vertically centered), switch to top when content has subtitle. Children: (1) Leading area (optional): Fixed 40×40 for avatar, or Fixed 24×24 for icon. Never Fill — leading items have known dimensions. (2) Content area: vertical AL, Fill width, gap 2px. Children: primary text (Fill width, Hug height) + secondary/subtitle text (Fill width, Hug height, optional via boolean). Fill on the content area is critical — it pushes the leading and trailing to their natural sizes and occupies all remaining space. (3) Trailing area (optional): Hug or Fixed depending on element — a chevron icon is Fixed 20×20, a price label is Hug, a toggle is Fixed. DIVIDER: 1px line at the bottom of the item is a child set to Absolute position, Fill width, Fixed 1px height, pinned to the bottom. Do NOT use a gap between items for dividers — that collapses when divider is hidden. OPTIMIZATION: Setting the content area to Fill is the only rule that matters for list items. Without it, the trailing area gets pushed to a random position.

Modal container: vertical AL, Fixed width (sm=480px, md=640px, lg=800px), Hug height with max-height via constraint. Padding: 0px (each section handles its own padding). Gap: 0px (sections are flush or divided by a 1px line). Children in order: (1) Header: horizontal AL, Fill width, Hug height. Padding: 24px. Gap: 16px. Children: title text (Fill width) + optional close-button (Fixed 40×40, in-flow, right-aligned via space-between on parent or Fill on title). (2) Divider (optional): Fill width, Fixed 1px height. (3) Body/Content: vertical AL, Fill width, Hug height. Padding: 24px. This section contains the modal's actual content. For scrollable body: in the implementation layer, not in Figma AL — keep Hug in design. (4) Divider. (5) Footer: horizontal AL, Fill width, Hug height. Padding: 16-24px. Gap: 8-12px. Children: cancel button (Hug) + confirm button (Hug), right-aligned via the 9-point grid (top-right or use Fill on a spacer — no, use space-between or align right with ML auto). OPTIMIZATION: Modal width is always Fixed — modals do not resize with the page. Max-height is a constraint not an AL property — in Figma, document it in annotations. The close button belongs in-flow in the header, not absolute — absolute close buttons cause header height to collapse.

Icon button: Fixed width × Fixed height. No auto layout needed inside for the icon — use vertical AL with center-center alignment. Sizes: sm=32×32px, md=40×40px, lg=48×48px. Padding: 0px — the Fixed dimension handles the touch target, and center alignment positions the icon. Icon child: Fixed 16×16 (sm), 20×20 (md), 20×20 (lg). The difference between the button size and icon size creates implicit padding. BORDER-RADIUS: radius/md (8px) for square icon buttons, radius/full (9999px) for circular icon buttons. OPTIMIZATION: Never use Hug on icon buttons — Hug makes the button shrink to the icon size, eliminating the touch target padding. Always Fixed. Min-width and min-height are unnecessary since both dimensions are Fixed. TOOLTIP: add a tooltip component as an absolute-positioned child (not in flow) pinned above or below the icon button. STATES: use border and background colour variables for hover/focus/active states. The icon colour changes via a colour variable scoped to fill colour.

Alert: horizontal AL, Fill width, Hug height. Padding: 16px. Gap: 12px. Alignment: top (icon aligns to first line of text when message wraps). Children: (1) Status icon: Fixed 20×20. (2) Content area: vertical AL, Fill width, gap 4px. Children: title text (Fill, Hug, optional) + body text (Fill, Hug). (3) Actions row (optional): horizontal AL, Hug, gap 8px. Children: action-link or button instances (Hug). (4) Close/dismiss button (optional): Fixed 20×20 or 40×40, in-flow, right-aligned — keep in flow, not absolute, so padding is consistent. BANNER (full-width, page-level): same structure but no border-radius and fills page width. INLINE ALERT (inside a form): same structure, typically no title, smaller padding (12px). OPTIMIZATION: The content area must Fill width so text wraps correctly. If content is set to Hug, text runs off-screen. Alignment top on the parent is essential — center alignment looks wrong when text wraps to 3+ lines because the icon floats to the vertical center.

Toggle track: horizontal AL, Fixed width × Fixed height (track: 48×28px standard, 40×24px compact). No padding (the thumb positions within the track via AL). Gap: 0px (thumb fills the track directionally via spacing). Alignment: center. The thumb is the single child: Fixed 20×20 (standard) or 16×16 (compact), with spacing from the edge to simulate the on/off state. ON state: thumb at the right — use padding-left equal to track-width minus thumb-size minus edge-gap (e.g. 48-20-4=24px left padding, 4px right padding). OFF state: thumb at the left — 4px left, 24px right. This avoids using absolute positioning for the thumb and keeps it in the AL flow. TOGGLE ROW (label + toggle): horizontal AL, Fill width, Hug height, gap 12px. Children: content area (vertical AL, Fill width) + toggle track (Fixed, right-aligned via Fill on content pushing it right). OPTIMIZATION: Never use absolute position for the thumb — the on/off state is handled by swapping left/right padding values via component variants. This is cleaner than repositioning an absolute element.

t: Bottom Navigation Bar — Mobile AL Structure
d: Bottom nav bar: horizontal AL, Fill width, Fixed height (49px iOS standard / 56dp Android Material). Padding: 0px top, safe-area-inset bottom (document in annotation, not Figma AL). Gap: 0px — children use Fill to divide space equally. Alignment: center. Children: 3–5 nav item frames, each Fill width, Fill height. Nav item: vertical AL, Fill width, Fill height, gap 4px, center-center alignment. Children: icon (Fixed 24×24) + label text (Hug width, Hug height, optional — hide via boolean for icon-only tabs). ACTIVE STATE: swap icon colour and label colour via variable, add optional indicator dot (absolute position, Fixed 4×4px, top-right of icon). OPTIMIZATION: Nav items must be Fill width — this is what distributes them evenly without explicit spacing. Fixed-width nav items break when the device width changes or when a 5th item is added. SAFE AREA: the 49px iOS height sits above the home indicator. In Figma, annotate the 34px safe area inset — do not add it as AL padding since it is a runtime value.

t: Avatar with Status Badge — Absolute Position Pattern
d: Avatar: Fixed width × Fixed height (16, 24, 32, 40, 48, 64, 80px common sizes). Use vertical AL with center-center alignment as the root. Clip content on (to create circular crop). Children: (1) image or initials layer: Fill width, Fill height. This is the main visual. (2) Status badge: positioned via absolute position. Fixed 10×10 or 12×12. Positioned bottom-right: pin to bottom and right edges with a small negative offset (-1px to -2px) to sit on the border, or exactly at the corner. Border on the status dot matches the parent background colour (2px white/dark border) to create the cut-out look. This border is a stroke, not a shadow. OPTIMIZATION: The status badge must be absolute — it overlaps the avatar circle. Keep the avatar clip-content ON so the image crops to the circle. If status badge is not needed, the avatar is simply Fixed × Fixed with center-aligned content and clip content. Do not add the status badge as a separate layer outside the avatar — it breaks instance management. All badge state variants (online/away/offline/busy) live as component variants of the status-dot child component, swapped via Instance Swap property.
